title: Exposure backstop incident playbook (WIP)
content:
Purpose:
This working playbook captures pragmatic, cross-functional backstops for exposure-level incidents during canary or A/B exposures of LLM features. It focuses on fast containment, minimal user impact, and preserving signal for root cause while enabling safe rollback.

Scope / when to use:
- Any canary/A-B exposure where model outputs create safety/segmentation/legal/regulatory risk (e.g., high-toxicity, PII leakage, gross hallucination on critical questions)
- Severe regressions in quality metrics for production prompt sets (e.g., quality delta > 15% vs baseline on evaluators)
- Operational incidents that impact user-facing inference (latency spikes > 2x, error-rate > 5% for 5+ minutes, or cost blowouts > 3x forecast)
- Not for localized unit-test failures or dev-only experiments.

Quick triage checklist (first 10 minutes):
1) Pause exposure: use Console -> Rollouts -> Pause/expose toggle to stop new traffic to the variant. If pause fails, proceed to immediate routing fallback (step 3).
2) Mark incident in tracker: open an incident JIRA (use template JIRA-INC-5xxx) and add preliminary tags (canary, severity, model). Assign an incident lead (product/eng).
3) Switch routing: route live traffic to safe fallback model (pre-configured fallback chain). Prefer the last known-good model version or a compact quantized variant with sandboxed outputs. Use routing policy: region->tier->model-variant.
4) Freeze rollouts & disable autoscale bursts for the affected Dedicated pool to avoid unbounded cost.
5) Capture repro + telemetry snapshot: export last 30 minutes of requests, top failing slices, latency histograms, and model logits (where safe). Save to incident artifact storage and attach to the ticket.

Signals and thresholds (operationalized):
- Latency SLO breach: p95 > target*2 for 5m -> alert pager and trigger routing to fallback.
- Error rate spike: 5xx > 5% or client error surge (4xx) with repeated prompt pattern -> auto-pause exposure after 1 minute sustained.
- Toxicity score: aggregate toxicity > 0.25 on validated toxicity classifier across sampled requests -> human-in-loop and exposure throttle to 1% while triaging.
- Hallucination drift: eval set QA F1 drop > 15% vs baseline -> suspend canary traffic and snapshot prompts for analysis.
- Cost delta: per-token cost > 3x forecast for 10m -> roll back to lower-cost variant and investigate batching/config.
- Human-reports: customer escalations or CS Safety reports (2+ escalations in 15m) -> immediate halt + executive notification.

Automated backstops (pre-configured):
- Circuit breakers (Tiered):
  * Safety circuit: triggers on toxicity/hallucination metrics -> throttle to 0.5% exposure, escalate to human reviewer.
  * Stability circuit: triggers on latency/5xx -> route to next fallback model automatically and notify SRE.
  * Cost circuit: triggers on cost anomaly -> reduce batch sizes and route non-critical traffic to archive/async queues.
- Telemetry guardrails: continuous sampling of top 2k responses per hour, run lightweight safety classifiers, and index hits into a quarantine corpus.
- Canary fallback chain: configured for each release: [variant-A (canary) -> last-good-major -> quantized-safe -> rules-based proxy].

Immediate manual interventions (if automation missed it):
- Stop ingestion of new user prompts for affected endpoint by flipping the emergency ingress toggle in Console.
- Revoke or rotate model keys for the variant (if compromised outputs show data exfil patterns).
- Turn off streaming for endpoints to reduce partial-output risk.
- Enable strict prompt sanitization filter (temporary) at the ingress layer.

Roles & communication matrix:
- Incident Lead (product) — coordinates triage, stakeholder comms, decision to roll back.
- Tech Lead (serving-runtime) — executes routing/fallback, verifies telemetry extraction, postmortem input.
- SRE Oncall — investigates infra causes for latency/error circuits and executes infra mitigations.
- Safety/Policy — fast review of sampled outputs, recommends content blocks and mitigation wording.
- CS/Support — prepares customer-facing comms and triages escalations.
- Legal/Compliance (if needed) — engaged for PII or regulatory exposures.
Notification levels:
- Pager (SRE) on stability & infra alarms.
- Slack incident channel created automatically via webhook when ticket opened. Add @product-leads, @safety, @cs, @sre-oncall.
- Exec alert if production-exposed users > 1000 affected or if regulatory boundary crossed.

Escalation steps (timeline):
- 0-10m: pause exposure & route fallback, create incident ticket.
- 10-30m: stabilize traffic & collect artifacts; Safety triage sampling.
- 30-90m: decision window — roll forward (with mitigations), roll back to last-good, or keep paused pending deeper rollback.
- 90m+: exec/Legal involvement if impact broad or regulatory.

Post-incident checklist (for the owning team):
- Collect reproducible prompt set and isolate minimal repro cases.
- Re-run evaluation harness on full production sample and baseline models.
- Create RCA draft with timeline, root cause hypotheses, and mitigation plan.
- Add regression tests & synthetic canary probes to catch the same pattern in future.
- Schedule a cross-team postmortem review within 7 days.

Playbook snippets (run commands & console pointers):
- Pause exposure: Console -> Rollouts -> [canary-id] -> Pause
- Route fallback via API: POST /v1/rollout/reroute {"canary_id":"c-xxx","target":"last-good"}
- Export sampling: Console -> Observability -> Export -> last 30m -> filter:canary=c-xxx

Open questions / TODOs (working):
- Standardize toxicity thresholding per product vertical (work with Safety) — TODO: Priya to draft by 2024-09-15.
- Define acceptable signal loss when we throttle to 0.1% — how much signal is needed for root cause? (Product + Research).
- Add automated partial-redaction layer (PII) before saving logs to incident store — Security to spec storage encryption & retention.
- Create a lightweight canary simulator that replays representative traffic across routing chains to validate fallback timing. (Owner: Jonah)

Quick reference decision heuristics (cheat sheet):
- If toxicity > threshold OR 2+ customer escalations -> Halt and escalate to Safety.
- If latency breach persists despite routing -> SRE-led infra rollback/scale and announce.
- If cost > 3x with no quality signal -> switch to quantized-safe and file billing incident.

Appendix: sample Slack message template (incident channel)
- "INCIDENT: Canary c-xxx paused at 2024-10-03 14:12 UTC. Trigger: toxicity spike > 0.25. Action: traffic routed to last-good. Incident lead: Marina. Pager: SRE oncall. Details: JIRA-INC-4821"

Notes to self (loose):
- Keep this doc intentionally lightweight; gate long policies in Confluence after consensus.
- Want a short set of runnable playbook scripts for Console and CLI.
- Follow up: schedule a short tabletop with SRE, Safety, CS in next sprint.
